economy.summary: His campaign says he has fought to protect unions, preserve workers' rights, raise the minimum wage, and invest in workforce development, and to protect consumers from predatory lenders and price gougers and aspiring homeowners from rent-to-own and discriminatory lending schemes.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage, protecting unions, consumer and homebuyer protections.

abortion.summary: Says abortion and personal health care decisions are between a woman and her doctor, not politicians, and that he will protect and defend women's access to abortion in Pennsylvania; notes a lifetime 100% voting scorecard from Planned Parenthood Pennsylvania Advocates.
abortion.short: Says he will protect and defend abortion access in Pennsylvania.

education.summary: Says legislation he authored created the Schools-to-Work program, funded in Governor Shapiro's first budget, developing career pathways for high-schoolers through partnerships between schools and local employers; the campaign frames this under workforce development.
education.short: Created Schools-to-Work program developing career pathways for high-schoolers.

energy.summary: Says Pennsylvania's existing environmental regulations do not do enough to protect the state's air, water, and health, and supports stronger environmental protections, including steeper civil fines and enhanced criminal charges to hold corporate polluters, frackers, and illegal dumpers accountable.
energy.short: Supports stronger environmental protections and penalties for polluters and frackers.

guns.summary: Says he supports commonsense gun reforms including stronger red-flag laws, a ban on assault weapons, expanded background checks, and closing the ghost gun loophole, and calls for a different type of policing with community engagement and officer training.
guns.short: Supports red-flag laws, assault weapons ban, expanded background checks.
